527:t_027:0.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「The enemy's destruction is confirmed, but neither Miss $$千鳥$$ nor $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$...」

527:t_027:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Even so, we were able to show $$アマルガム$$ our resolve. That is enough for now.」

527:t_027:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「...Al, how long did it take?」

527:t_027:3.en:
$$アル$$
「Unfortunately, more than four minutes have elapsed. I judge the Sergeant's statement to have been a bluff.」

527:t_027:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「That is what's called a figure of speech.」

527:t_027:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「Besides, results like these are unthinkable under normal circumstances.」

527:t_027:6.en:
$n
「Don't talk like it was all your doing.」

527:t_027:7.en:
$$カレン$$
「Right, right. It's only thanks to all of us doing our best, you know.」

527:t_027:10.en:
$$宗介$$
「Still... I'm glad you're safe, Al.」

527:t_027:12.en:
$$アル$$
「That much, at least, I tell you from my heart.」

527:t_027:13.en:
$$宗介$$
「Hmph... Talking about a heart, for a machine...」

527:t_027:14.en:
$$宗介$$
(It's like a conversation between comrades-in-arms, but strangely, it doesn't feel bad...)

527:t_027:15.en:
$$マオ$$
「Machine spotted to the north-northeast! It's the one trying to get away from here using $$ＥＣＳ$$!」

527:t_028:0.en:
$$かなめ$$
「...$$宗介$$... can you hear me...?」

527:t_028:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「I am calm! There's no problem!」

527:t_028:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「I have so much I want to tell you! There's too much to explain, but I made it this far, hesitating all the way!」

527:t_028:7.en:
$$宗介$$
「Is there an enemy beside you!? Then...!」

527:t_028:12.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Don't chase me... Right now I'm with $$カリーニン$$. And $$レナード$$ too.」

527:t_028:15.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Poor $$レナード$$... Even so, I thought about running away many times, but I realized it's impossible after all.」

527:t_028:16.en:
$$かなめ$$
「We can never beat those people. The more I resist, the more people get hurt...」

527:t_028:17.en:
$$かなめ$$
「So I'm sorry. Really, please don't chase me anymore...」

527:t_028:18.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I'm truly happy that you keep chasing me. But still...」

527:t_028:19.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$千鳥$$, what are you saying?」

527:t_028:20.en:
$$かなめ$$
「So, $$宗介$$... Please... forget about me...」

527:t_028:22.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Please, understand already... We can't anymore...」

527:t_028:23.en:
$$宗介$$
(I don't want to understand that...! A world without $$千鳥$$ has no meaning to me!)

527:t_028:28.en:
$$かなめ$$
「$$宗介$$... As the former student council vice president, I'm giving you an order. Okay?」

527:t_028:30.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I don't care what sacrifices it takes! Mobilize everything you have... all those completely useless, outrageous, nuisance-to-everyone soldier skills of yours...」

527:t_028:31.en:
$$かなめ$$
「No matter how dangerous the enemy is, beat them to a pulp and come hug me!! You can do that, can't you!?」

527:t_028:33.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'll definitely come. Wait for me.」

527:t_028:35.en:
$$宗介$$
「I do too. I love you.」

527:t_028:37.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Then, the next time we properly meet, let's definitely kiss.」

527:t_028:38.en:
$$かなめ$$
「With all we've got. Anywhere. Okay? It's a promise, all right?」

527:t_028:40.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I'll wait for years, even hundreds of years...」

527:t_028:41.en:
$$宗介$$
「It's all right. I'll definitely catch you.」

527:t_030:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「This much is nothing to me now.」

527:t_030:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Hold on, $$ファイヤバグ$$! The job of putting you all out of your misery is mine!」

527:t_031:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Not bad. I can't afford to lose either.」

527:t_031:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Hold on, $$ファイヤバグ$$! The job of putting you all out of your misery is mine!」

527:t_032:0.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Heh... Apparently my sideburns have been wearing down without my even noticing...」

527:t_032:1.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Goodbye, life... Long live the great $$ゲイツ$$...」

527:t_033:1.en:
$$マオ$$
「So that's the end of that pervert...」

527:t_033:2.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Who knows. Knowing him, we might run into him again on some battlefield.」

527:t_033:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「In that case, I'll just send him back to hell once more.」

527:t_033:4.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「I-I won't die! Sideburns, beard, who cares! I'll survive by any means necessary!」

527:t_034:0.en:
$$マオ$$
「So that's the end of that pervert...」

527:t_034:1.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Who knows. Knowing him, we might run into him again on some battlefield.」

527:t_034:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「In that case, I'll just send him back to hell once more.」

527:t_035:0.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「I-I won't die! I refuse to die in a place like this!」

527:t_035:1.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Retreat while the $$エクルビス$$ still moves! Remember this, $$キリコ$$! And also...」

527:t_036:0.en:
$$カレン$$
「Even $$カン・ユー$$ wasn't in a position this time to leisurely deliver a parting shot, it seems.」

527:t_036:1.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「His tenacity makes even me, the immortal, tip my hat.」

527:t_036:2.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Hahaha, $$カン・ユー$$! That's why you'll never be first-rate!」
